column1: # SdrfQuantAuditor over the curated SDRF corpus -- bigbio/sdrf-annotated-datasets, the
# `datasets` subtree only. The clone also carries a `sandbox` directory of further files that
# are NOT part of the curated corpus; counting those is one way an earlier survey of this
# corpus produced numbers nobody could reproduce.
# WHAT THIS FILE IS FOR. Three independent surveys of this corpus returned 49, 51 and 52
# channel-level TMT files, and 31 versus 32 kit-only. The qualitative findings agreed; the
# integers did not, and none of them was produced by code anyone could re-run. These counts are,
# THE SPREAD WAS SCOPE, NOT ARITHMETIC. 51 channel-level and 31 kit-only is exactly right for
# the TMT family alone, which is what those surveys were counting. iTRAQ adds 10 and 6, giving
# the 61 and 37 below. Both are recorded so that a future disagreement is a scope question with
# an answer rather than three integers and no way to choose between them.
# WHEN THIS FILE HAS TO CHANGE. The corpus is a living upstream repository, so it will grow.
# A failing test here is not a bug by itself -- it says the corpus or the classifier moved.
# Work out which, then update these counts IN THE SAME COMMIT as the change that moved them,
# so the diff records what changed and why.
# Measured 2026-08-28 against corpus commit: see data/PROVENANCE.md in the QuantProject folder.
